SELECT 
	TType='Sales',
	AliasName = A.AliasName,
	CustomerName=A.Name,
	NTN = S.NTNNo,
	NetAmount=SUM(P.InvTotal),
	TaxCategory = TC.Name,
	AdvanceTaxPerc = TC.TaxPerc,
	AdvanceTaxAmt = SUM(P.AdvanceTaxAmt)
FROM
	SaleLedger P, Accounts A, Customer S, TaxCategory TC
WHERE
	:ai_allcust = 0 AND
	P.Posted = 'Y' AND
	P.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
	P.CustCode IN (:ai_Custcode) AND
	P.CustCode = S.CustCode AND
	S.CustCode = A.AccCode AND
	S.TaxCategoryCode = TC.TaxCategoryCode
GROUP BY
	A.AliasName,
	A.Name,
	S.NTNNo,
	TC.Name,
	TC.TaxPerc
UNION ALL
